svg.title: Sign-in and session
svg.desc: 1. The password is checked with scrypt and a constant-time comparison; unknown emails are checked against a dummy hash so timing reveals nothing. 2. A random 32-byte token is issued and only its SHA-256 hash is stored, valid for 12 hours. 3. A global hook resolves the session on every request and re-checks that the account is still active. 4. Signing out deletes the session row, so access ends on the next request; a password change ends all other sessions.
